authority: Finance Act 2024 - capital gains rates revised w.e.f. 2024-07-23
Income-tax Act 2025 - in force from 2026-04-01 (replaces Income-tax Act 1961)
principles: The rate is decided by the DATE OF SALE, not the date the gain accrued.
The 2024-07-23 changeover is binary: no pro-rating of a single sale across the cutoff.
The LTCG exemption applies to LONG-TERM gains only; it never shelters short-term gains.
The LTCG exemption is per taxpayer per financial year and must still be declared in Schedule CG even when fully sheltered.
The long-term test is a date comparison against the 12-month anniversary. An integer month count truncates and would misclassify a holding of 12 months and N days as short term.

equity_oriented.description: Equity-oriented classification must be established from the statutory domestic-equity test and verified portfolio-composition evidence for the relevant period; a scheme-category label alone is insufficient.

long_term.exemption_scope: aggregate LTCG of this class for the financial year
long_term.exemption_order: highest-rate gains are sheltered first; losses are netted before the exemption
long_term.holding_period_rule: MORE THAN 12 months from the date of acquisition. Exactly 12 months is SHORT term. Income-tax Act s.2(42A). Test against the 12-month anniversary date, not an integer month count.

debt_purchased_on_or_after_2023_04_01.description: Mutual-fund units acquired on or after 2023-04-01. Tax treatment depends on whether the units qualify as a specified mutual fund under the provision in force on the transfer date; do not infer solely from a debt/hybrid scheme label.
applies_to: non-equity funds of funds where statutory conditions are met
debt_purchased_on_or_after_2023_04_01.note: If the statutory specified-mutual-fund test is met, gains are deemed short-term regardless of actual holding period and taxed at the applicable rate. If not met, apply the otherwise applicable asset-class and holding-period rules. Require verified acquisition date and composition evidence.

debt_purchased_before_2023_04_01.description: Debt mutual fund units acquired before 2023-04-01, held 36 months or more.
debt_purchased_before_2023_04_01.note: Indexation advantage removed from 2024-07-23. This is a genuine deterioration for long-held debt units; do not assume grandfathered indexation benefit.

gold_etf.description: Gold ETFs are generally non-equity products, but specified-mutual-fund status must be established under the applicable date-specific statutory test and verified portfolio composition; do not hard-code classification from the product label.

international_and_non_equity_fof.description: International funds and FoFs holding less than 65% equity.

classification_test.note: Never assume a tax class from a category label. Derive statutory classifications independently (equity-oriented, specified mutual fund, MLD and other asset classes) using the correct provision, sale date, acquisition date and source evidence.

engine_requirements: Never hard-code a rate in a report or script. Load it from this file.
Never reuse a gain figure computed under a different financial year or a different rate version.
If as_of is more than 180 days older than the reporting date, refuse to publish tax figures and flag for review.

cost_inflation_index._provenance: CBDT notification-wise Cost Inflation Index, base year 2001-02 = 100.
cost_inflation_index._note: Published annually. This is a dated statutory table, NOT a formula. An earlier linear approximation ((y-2001)/2+1) overstated the index by up to 3.49x and silently reduced the client's tax; see docs/issues.md W6. Do not interpolate or extrapolate.

section_194k_tds.description: TDS on income in respect of units of a Mutual Fund under Section 194K of Income Tax Act
section_194k_tds.exemption: Dividends up to INR 5,000 per financial year per AMC are exempt from TDS (though taxable in slab)

section_50AA_1961.note: Use original Section 50AA definition for transfers through 2026-03-31. Do not apply the successor debt/money-market test to FY 2025-26.

section_76_2025.note: Do not use a point-in-time allocation, an inferred equity complement, or an unverified caller-supplied coverage flag as a substitute for the statutory annual-average calculation.

exit_load_schedules_note: These are generic indicative defaults only. Actual scheme/plan/lot-specific exit-load schedules from current official scheme documents control; missing exit-load evidence must not be represented as zero.

fund_of_funds_conditions: minimum 90% of total proceeds in units of another fund traded on a recognised stock exchange
underlying fund invests minimum 90% of its total proceeds in domestic listed equity shares
evidence_required: all 12 monthly opening and closing portfolio-composition observations
verified scheme structure and underlying-fund eligibility
equity_oriented_classification.note: Do not substitute point-in-time equity allocation or an annual average of daily closing values for the statutory monthly-average method.
